tasks.title: Repository Setup and Initial Rebranding
tasks.description: Fork the Gemini CLI repository, rename to Convergio CLI, and implement basic rebranding to establish the foundation for development.
tasks.details:
1. Fork the existing Gemini CLI repository
2. Rename repository to Convergio CLI
3. Update package.json with new name, version, and description
4. Replace all instances of 'gemini' CLI command with 'convergio'
5. Update ASCII art and logos with Convergio branding
6. Modify help text and documentation to reflect new product name
7. Ensure all existing functionality continues to work
8. Set up CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
9. Configure Docker development environment with Node.js 20+
10. Create initial README with project overview and setup instructions
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify CLI binary name change from 'gemini' to 'convergio'
2. Run existing test suite to ensure all functionality is preserved
3. Manual verification of branding elements in CLI output
4. Confirm CI/CD pipeline successfully builds and tests the application
5. Test Docker development environment setup on multiple platforms

2. Integration tests verifying correct routing of different request types
3. Mock external dependencies to test error handling and fallbacks

tasks.title: Agent Factory Implementation

tasks.title: AutoGen Integration for Multi-Agent Conversations
tasks.description: Integrate Microsoft AutoGen framework to enable sophisticated multi-agent conversations with different collaboration patterns.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for AutoGen integration components
2. Test different collaboration patterns with mock agents
3. Verify tool sharing and coordination works correctly
4. Integration tests for complete multi-agent conversations
5. Performance testing with multiple concurrent agents

subtasks.title: AutoGen Dependency Integration and Wrapper Classes
subtasks.description: Set up AutoGen framework dependencies and create wrapper classes to interface with the existing system
subtasks.details:
Implementation Approach: Install AutoGen dependencies via pip, create abstract wrapper classes that encapsulate AutoGen's agent functionality while exposing a consistent API for our system. Define base agent types (Assistant, User, GroupChat) with standardized interfaces.

Integration Challenges: Version compatibility issues between AutoGen and existing dependencies. Memory management for large conversation contexts. Handling of AutoGen's async patterns in our synchronous architecture.

Testing Strategy: Unit tests for wrapper classes with mock AutoGen objects. Integration tests with simple agent interactions. Dependency validation tests to ensure compatibility across environments.

subtasks.title: Agent Bridge Implementation
subtasks.description: Develop bridge components to connect our existing agent system with AutoGen's agent architecture
subtasks.details:
Implementation Approach: Create adapter patterns to translate between our agent protocols and AutoGen's message formats. Implement message transformation utilities, state synchronization mechanisms, and agent lifecycle management. Build configuration mappers to translate our agent settings to AutoGen parameters.

Integration Challenges: Maintaining state consistency between systems. Handling different error models and recovery mechanisms. Managing the impedance mismatch between AutoGen's design patterns and our existing architecture.

Testing Strategy: Component tests for each bridge element. Scenario-based tests for different agent interaction patterns. Stress tests for high-volume message passing between systems.

subtasks.title: Collaboration Patterns and Group Chat Management
subtasks.description: Implement various collaboration patterns for multi-agent conversations and group chat orchestration
subtasks.details:
Implementation Approach: Build pattern templates for common collaboration scenarios (sequential, parallel, hierarchical). Implement group chat controllers that manage agent participation, turn-taking, and conversation flow. Create conversation lifecycle hooks for initialization, termination, and state transitions.

Integration Challenges: Handling complex conversation topologies. Managing agent priority and interruption patterns. Ensuring conversation coherence across multiple agents with different capabilities.

Testing Strategy: Behavioral tests for each collaboration pattern. Simulation tests with scripted multi-agent scenarios. Validation tests for conversation coherence and goal achievement.

subtasks.title: Tool Coordination and Context Management
subtasks.description: Develop systems for coordinating tools across agents and managing shared context
subtasks.details:
Implementation Approach: Create a tool registry and permission system for agent tool access. Implement context managers that maintain and update shared knowledge across conversation participants. Build context serialization and deserialization utilities for persistence.

Integration Challenges: Preventing tool conflicts between agents. Managing context size and relevance over long conversations. Handling tool execution failures gracefully within conversations.

Testing Strategy: Tool interaction tests with multiple agents. Context consistency tests across conversation state changes. Performance tests for context management with large knowledge bases.

subtasks.title: Conversation Visualization and History Tracking
subtasks.description: Implement visualization components and history tracking for multi-agent conversations
subtasks.details:
Implementation Approach: Develop a conversation history data model with indexing and query capabilities. Create visualization components for conversation flow, agent contributions, and tool usage. Implement export/import functionality for conversation analysis.

Integration Challenges: Efficiently storing and retrieving large conversation histories. Representing complex multi-agent interactions visually. Maintaining performance with real-time visualization updates.

Testing Strategy: UI/UX tests for visualization components. Performance tests for history storage and retrieval. Usability testing with sample conversation datasets of varying complexity.

tasks.title: Security Implementation and Compliance
tasks.description: Implement security features, authentication, authorization, and ensure compliance with privacy regulations.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Security scanning with automated tools
2. Penetration testing for authentication flows
3. Verify encryption implementation with test vectors
4. Test access control with different user roles
5. Audit log verification for security events

subtasks.title: Data Encryption and Secure Transport
subtasks.description: Implement end-to-end encryption for data at rest and in transit using industry-standard protocols.
subtasks.details: Requirements: Implement AES-256 encryption for data at rest; Use TLS 1.3 for all API communications; Implement secure key management system; Ensure proper certificate validation. Implementation Approach: Utilize encryption libraries compatible with the tech stack; Configure proper HTTPS settings; Implement certificate pinning for mobile clients; Create automated rotation for encryption keys. Verification Methods: Conduct penetration testing; Verify encryption with tools like Wireshark; Perform security code review; Test certificate validation against invalid certificates.

subtasks.title: OAuth 2.0 Authentication Implementation
subtasks.description: Develop and integrate OAuth 2.0 authentication flow with secure token management.
subtasks.details: Requirements: Implement OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow; Support refresh tokens with appropriate expiration; Implement PKCE for mobile clients; Ensure secure token storage. Implementation Approach: Integrate with identity provider (e.g., Auth0, Okta); Implement JWT validation; Create secure token storage mechanism; Develop session management with proper timeout. Verification Methods: Test authentication flows with various scenarios; Verify token validation logic; Conduct session hijacking tests; Perform OAuth 2.0 implementation security audit.

subtasks.title: Access Control and Authorization
subtasks.description: Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system with fine-grained permissions.
subtasks.details: Requirements: Design role hierarchy with principle of least privilege; Implement attribute-based access control where needed; Support dynamic permission changes; Create API endpoint authorization. Implementation Approach: Develop centralized authorization service; Implement permission checks at API gateway level; Create role management interfaces; Design database schema for roles and permissions. Verification Methods: Test access control with different user roles; Verify permission inheritance; Conduct authorization bypass testing; Create automated tests for all permission combinations.

subtasks.title: Audit Logging and Security Monitoring
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive audit logging and real-time security monitoring system.
subtasks.details: Requirements: Log all authentication attempts and access control decisions; Implement tamper-evident logs; Create real-time alerting for suspicious activities; Support log retention policies. Implementation Approach: Utilize centralized logging system (e.g., ELK stack); Implement structured logging format; Develop monitoring dashboards; Create automated alerting system. Verification Methods: Test log integrity; Verify alert triggers with simulated attacks; Conduct log analysis exercises; Validate log retention and rotation.

subtasks.title: Compliance Features and Data Protection
subtasks.description: Implement features required for regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) and data protection.
subtasks.details: Requirements: Implement data anonymization and pseudonymization; Create data subject access request handling; Support right to be forgotten; Implement data breach notification system. Implementation Approach: Develop privacy by design patterns; Create data classification system; Implement consent management; Develop compliance documentation. Verification Methods: Conduct compliance gap analysis; Perform privacy impact assessment; Test data subject request workflows; Verify data deletion and anonymization effectiveness.
